required_documents.name: SF424 (R&R) Application Form Package
required_documents.details: Standard federal application cover component with applicant organization UEI, contact information, and authorized representative signature.

required_documents.name: Project Summary / Abstract & Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Project abstract (max 30 lines) summarizing proposed aims and methodology, plus two to three sentences describing public health relevance.
required_documents.source: NOAA-NOS-NCCOS-2026-32934.pdf Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Senior/Key Person Profiles and Biosketches
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches for PD/PI and all senior/key personnel (max 5 pages each). eRA Commons username must be entered in the Credential field.
required_documents.source: NOAA-NOS-NCCOS-2026-32934.pdf Section IV.2 Senior/Key Person Profile

required_documents.name: R&R Budget and Itemized Budget Justification
required_documents.details: Detailed line-item budget covering direct costs, allowable indirect costs, personnel effort, and budget narrative justification.

required_documents.name: Specific Aims & Research Strategy
required_documents.details: One page of Specific Aims and structured Research Strategy covering Significance, Innovation, and Approach adhering strictly to published page limits.
required_documents.source: NOAA-NOS-NCCOS-2026-32934.pdf Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Facilities & Other Resources and Equipment
required_documents.details: Documentation of laboratory facilities, core equipment, administrative space, and collaborative resources supporting the project.
required_documents.source: NOAA-NOS-NCCOS-2026-32934.pdf Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Letters of Support and Institutional Commitment
required_documents.details: Letters from key scientific collaborators, advisory committee members, core facilities, or leadership guaranteeing institutional support.
required_documents.source: NOAA-NOS-NCCOS-2026-32934.pdf Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: SAM.gov UEI and eRA Commons Registrations
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and valid eRA Commons credentials for the organization and lead investigators.

eligibility.summary: State governments, county and city municipal agencies, tribal entities, and qualifying regional authorities in North Carolina are eligible.

cost_share.details: Cost sharing requirements not explicitly mandated in notice.

submission_limits: Only one application per institution is permitted; internal institutional screening required.
important_notes: Applications must be submitted electronically through the designated portal prior to the deadline: 2027-02-12.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Ensure all project narrative and attachment page limits are strictly respected to avoid administrative rejection without review.
